messages:
Talia B: quick thought  product wants the console to show why an SLO alert didn't page. can we design a tiny "notify rationale" that surfaces the evaluated chain?
Marco D: yes. server should return a single `notify_rationale` blob: sensitivity_label, computed_threshold, reason_chain (max 3), cost_snapshot. front-end just renders it.
Ivy H: prefer server-side computation to avoid mismatches. plus runtime can attach the exact eval timestamp and the fallback reason if it soft-snoozed.
Talia B: UX: show sensitivity pill (low/med/high), then "last action" line: e.g., "manual override (2h) by @marco" or "auto-snooze: quota-backpressure". small link to full telemetry.
Marco D: API note: GET /v1/tenants/:id/notify-rationale?at=timestamp returning flat fields is ideal. include cost_snapshot only (last_1h_est) to keep cardinality down.
Ivy H: guardrails for overrides: non-admin TTL <= 6h, team-admin <= 72h. server must emit immutable audit event for any POST /overrides. and rate-limit override writes per tenant.
Talia B: rollout plan: stage A read-only rationale in console; stage B enable button for sandbox tenants to create short overrides; stage C enable prod with admin gating + audit retention.
ops-bot: synthetic: notify-eval emitted for tenant sandbox-19 at 4098765438 (no page) :white_check_mark:
Marco D: telemetry: runtime should emit compact notify-eval events to our metrics stream that include which rule decided (tier/override/fallback) and the exposure percentage at eval time. helps UX examples.
QA Bot: QA tasks: 1) synth SLOs for sandbox to validate explain strings; 2) verify cost_snapshot within 5% of billing snapshot; 3) confirm no emails or PII in payloads.
Ivy H: last API debate: should explain_chain be strings or structured objects? lean strings to simplify frontend and avoid nested payloads. also cap length.
Talia B: agreed. keep it human-readable short sentences. I'll draft the API contract and UI mockups and share before Thurs.
Marco D: assigning PR to eng-runtime + eng-platform, label `notify-rationale-ux`, ETA next milestone.
Ivy H: one more ops note: ensure the rationale endpoint respects tenant routing policies (region/fallback) so console shows what runtime would actually apply.
Talia B: perfect, thanks all. we'll iterate on wording in the contract.
